scope: Offline boundary and budget review for six isolated failed-DRIFT retries. No new model results or scoring reviewed.

independent_test.writes: Temporary synthetic run directories plus the new test and review files only.
independent_test.network_guard: Audit hook rejects socket/HTTP dispatch, credential paths and writes under original .cache.

verified_boundaries: Only Q08/Q10/Q11/Q14/Q16/Q18 routed_graphrag/drift cells can be opened; other question/method/route combinations are rejected.
All global carry counters and all six original per-cell input totals are retained. The manifest exactly matches the immutable old ledger request metadata and history.
Twelve prior successful HyDE/embedding responses replay with exact hashes, no transport dispatch, no new reservation and explicit old-event provenance.
HyDE and primer request bodies must match inherited keys; relabeling an existing key to a different stage/service is rejected.
Each old failed primer already used one attempt. Only two further physical attempts remain; a transient failure after its second cumulative attempt waits 15 seconds, then the third failure stops.
Completed valid new responses are reused without new dispatch, including after restart. Complete decoder failure is not retried and known diagnostic provider usage is retained.
Permission, safety and explicitly non-dispatched failures do not retry. Unknown crash with no complete durable response stops for review and keeps the reserved counts and unknown usage.
A complete durable response recovered after process loss is validated and reused without a new dispatch or fabricated attempt.

Resume rejects counter resets, per-cell carry resets, prior-attempt resets, missing inherited records, altered request bodies/service/history, cache hash changes and mismatched event stage/cell metadata.
Same-process new cache use checks completed response SHA; locking rejects a concurrent controller for the same isolated directory.

Static runner/transport review confirms fixed isolated run path, six-cell selection, original protocol/input/implementation gates, exact reserved payload validation, parent-process binding, original endpoints and 120/30-second request limits.

resolved_findings.finding: Inherited zero-new-event records and cell metadata were insufficiently reconstructed on resume; existing request stages could be relabeled.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent strengthened inherited records/body/service/history/cell route/input/stage reconstruction and stage binding; mutation tests now reject.

resolved_findings.finding: New response cache reuse within the same process did not check its stored completed SHA.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent added hash validation before cached response parsing; independently reproduced failure before the fix and rejection after it.

resolved_findings.finding: Resume accepted event.stage differing from the corresponding cell request metadata.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent bound event cell/key/stage/service; independently reproduced failure before the fix and rejection after it.

budget.generation_formula: 6 * (2 remaining primer attempts + 5 new generation requests * 3 attempts)
budget.qualification: Bounds assume the unchanged official DRIFT k2/depth2/fold1 control flow: at most four new Local subcalls and one reduce per cell, plus four new embedding requests. Every actual reservation counts; per-cell 64k limits may stop a cell before all allowed attempts finish.

other_evidence.official_integration: Read parent-produced offline-integration.json: six real official DRIFT paths, each exact inherited primer key, two inherited cache uses and synthetic primer + four Local + reduce. This artifact was inspected, not rerun by this review.
other_evidence.transport_and_decoder: Separate independent decoder-review.json and transport/decoder tests are bound above; this review concentrates on inherited runtime accounting and replay.

limitations: Synthetic transport tests verify execution boundaries only; they do not predict retry success or answer quality.
Old six decoder failures lack retained raw SSE. Their precise message contents and diagnostic usage cannot be reconstructed or treated as zero.
This is a conditional retry on known failed questions after a decoder change. Original outcomes and scores must remain, and changes cannot be attributed solely to decoder compatibility.
No live-readiness file was created, no paid run was launched, and no old ledger, graph, cache, question, route, prompt or score was changed by this review.
